title: Is Trump's Vocabulary Poor? Vocabulary Richness Across Texts of Different Lenghts
abstract: arXiv:2609.17747v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study explores the vocabulary richness of oral political communication. A model explaining the lexicon growth is proposed by subdividing the whole vocabulary into terms generated by general and specialized glossaries.

Title: Is Trump's Vocabulary Poor? Vocabulary Richness Across Texts of Different Lenghts
Abstract: arXiv:2609.17747v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study explores the vocabulary richness of oral political communication. A model explaining the lexicon growth is proposed by subdividing the whole vocabulary into terms generated by general and specialized glossaries.
translated_title: 特朗普的词汇贫乏吗？不同长度文本的词汇丰富度研究
translated_abstract: 本研究探讨了口头政治传播中的词汇丰富度。通过将整个词汇细分为由通用词汇表和专业词汇表生成的词条，提出了一个解释词汇量增长的模型。
tldr: 本研究提出将词汇细分为通用与专业词汇表来解释词汇量增长的模型，以此评估口头政治传播中的词汇丰富度。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a model explaining vocabulary growth by subdividing the lexicon into terms from general and specialized glossaries, in order to assess vocabulary richness in oral political communication.
